The wrapper calls grBigBlue_801EF424 before Ground_801C2FE0; the updater dispatches four indexed updates and terminates separation on either a correction-free pass or the ten-pass limit. The proposal and functionality document correctly avoid a convergence guarantee.

Independently verified every cited controller range, including the LaneSpeed definition. The current proposal explicitly preserves multiplication by Ground_801C0498(), distinguishes placement/probe/query geometry from stored x44.x horizontal translation, and accurately identifies persistent writes and final collision-maintenance request. This resolves the stale resume blocker and contradicts the inherited disposition's fixed-components rationale without requiring replacement of the current proposal.

Independently verified initial states, coordination-dependent positive delays, the valid-edge-sample gate, bounded upward retries and above-camera fallback, reveal into state 3, directional exits, reset and half-delay recycling. The document preserves the same exceptional branches and does not confuse hiding with destruction.

contradictions.reason: Accept the section/storage deferrals for the .data, .rodata, .sbss, .sdata and .sdata2 claim families and section-level links. Source declarations establish aggregate contents, callback registration and pointer locality, but not compiled membership, boundaries, literal pools or a generated jump table. The 32-entry identifier aggregate is consumed by the collision-intersection query, so that consumption is now corroborated; compiled placement remains deferred. The precise mpLib_80057424 semantics also remain deferred.

Accept the raw collision-record deferrals. The callback has numeric collision guards, a 30-entry joint lookup and assertion, and four raw-stride matching writes at offset 0xF4; it does not independently test activity. Typed gravity affects height elsewhere, but equating the raw write with that typed field or a visible bounce still requires layout evidence. This reconciles the four collision facts and the collision-to-hazard link without importing rendered names.

Accept startup and lifetime qualifications. Fixed setup order, required-result dereferences, camera/blast-zone configuration and collision deactivation are supported. The directional constructor stores the supplied count; the examined maintenance pass decrements only positive counts and recycles zero counts. Thus -1 is not aged to zero by this pass, but complete construction and other lifetime consumers remain deferred rather than asserting unconditional persistence. Null-descriptor manager startup and item/coin bookkeeping do not alone establish the broader minor-enemy mapping.

Accept the broader actor/presentation deferrals across stage registration, component initialization, track motion, three-record platforms, FFlyer and route-relative objects. Canonical stage identity, model motion, visibility and coordination are supported, but exact asset identity, size, playability and the full F-Zero hazard composition are not proved by numeric IDs or rendered names. The FFlyer diagnostic and its proximity calls corroborate that controller's participation, but do not resolve every stronger presentation assertion.

Accept collision-propagation and shared-record gameplay deferrals. The road wrapper orders movement, global record maintenance and map collision processing. Ground_801C2FE0 is map-gated and processes/stamps selected collision joints; complete transform propagation through mpLib_80055E9C remains deferred. Movement and the common processing connection are now independently corroborated, so earlier unread-callee reasons are historical limitations, not current findings. The maintenance body supports aging/recycling, not a complete wind gameplay mapping.

Accept allocation/layout and model-group deferrals. The initializer allocates 120 and 30 bytes, traverses 30 model slots, reparents models, adjusts the tenth child, and narrows its timer to s16. Assignments and assertions use different union arms; their exact alias correspondence and compiled element layout are not established here. Thirty prepared model slots do not imply thirty simultaneously active hazards or spatial route lanes. Cleanup explicitly frees and nulls both stored allocations.

Accept bounded-termination supersession and reject any final-spacing guarantee. A correction can still have occurred on the tenth pass when the loop exits; collision processing follows return regardless. The proposal retains proven ordering and four-record processing without strengthening the unresolved visible-racer mapping.

Reconcile the controller supersessions against the current proposal rather than the stale handoff rationale. LaneSpeed does not supply fixed components alone: it multiplies by Ground_801C0498(). The current proposal and document correctly preserve that dependency for geometry and separately identify x44.x translation. Placement obstruction permits bounded upward retries and an above-camera fallback before activation; positive delays can be cleared by coordination. Shared-slot writes are supported without assigning an unproved racer identity.

Accept item identity, item-switch and RNG-distribution deferrals. The activation-time caller is now independently corroborated, as are five-candidate compaction, nonempty selection, joint-relative placement, numeric-kind-dependent offsets and handle storage. Those operations do not prove every user-facing item name, the predicate's configuration semantics, uniform RNG distribution or a transitively stateless helper. The item-placement and item-switch links remain qualified accordingly.

Accept the maximum-Y query's layout-dependent deferrals, including its inferred CarLane qualification and racer link. Strict bounds, maximum accumulation, sentinel and semantic top/bottom/left/right wrapper flow are supported. Repeated Ground-pointer rebasing prevents treating successive state and position accesses as four corresponding compiled lane records without additional evidence. The companion proximity query demonstrably tests map object 32's root under a state gate; that numeric selection must not be silently remapped to a different actor.

Confirm rejection of the vertical-motion and unconditional-capacity claims. Initialization clears raw 0xD8, but the process uses it for X translation and updates Y separately. State 3 is assigned before scanning three slots, and exhaustion does not undo that transition. The previously malformed citation is corrected to the exact pinned revision.

Reconcile callback association separately from implementation. The two callback3 installation deferrals now have corroborating table, installer and empty-body evidence: callback3 is assigned to x1C_callback when present. Conversely, the constant-false Boolean endpoints do not themselves implement moving-platform or racing hazards, and the local installer does not invoke their Boolean slot. Accept the inert-platform link rejection and preserve the stronger hazard-link deferral; no new fact or link write is needed.

Accept the route-controller dependency qualification and related gameplay deferrals. The activation guard reads raw map-32 +0xD0, not an independently identified racer manager. Its timer resets, candidate validation, reveal, surface-relative motion and hiding are supported. Collision-carrying fighting-terrain and hovering-asset identities remain deferred. The mixed distance/Y accumulator in the height query is preserved as reconstruction-sensitive rather than normalized into nearest-height selection.

Confirm the track-initialization rejection and transition qualifications. Explicit scale writes target segment JObjs, not every endpoint; road X/Y start at nonzero scaled values. prev_lane is assigned from cur_lane, not subsequently consumed in the replacement body. The assertion guard is count++ > 1000, not an exact 1000-attempt bound. Connected geometry and surface-query consumers are supported, while stronger visible-course mappings and the repeated collision-ID operation remain qualified.

Accept configured-count, scheduler and layout qualifications. Four indexed records are processed, but initialization can leave records inactive. Thirty entries are model-slot statuses, not proven spatial route lanes. Class balancing depends on convertible entries; proximity-driven packed insertions exist only under MUST_MATCH, while the alternative stores loaded bytes unchanged. Scheduling, spawn calls and success-dependent timer reset are corroborated, but the full route-allocation/hazard link and compiled 0x40 record correspondence remain deferred.

Confirm the restricted-retirement and current-X rejections. Y < -2000 is tested only within states 2–6 and 10; states 1, 7, 8 and 9 do not execute that check. State-10 acceleration branches on current pos.x, not remembered side of origin. Transition state 9 can mutate state without returning success. Motion and fade calls are supported, but precise engine-sound and visible-hazard identities remain deferred, including the motion/audio link.

Accept the remaining external-consumer and provenance deferrals. The displacement provider and dispatcher are supported, but downstream position application remains unverified. Current CPU code corroborates a floor-result veto through the Big Blue predicate, not every blocked-navigation/destination assertion. Source cannot authenticate either historical PR relationship. Six selected joints are passed to Ground_801C4E70, but this call alone does not prove camera-relative fog semantics.

Accept both transitive-mutation deferrals. The shadow predicate directly performs a strict height comparison without direct stage-state writes, but its origin helper can invoke HSD_JObjSetupMatrix on the supplied joint. The document correctly avoids asserting that the entire call chain is mutation-free. Supported inherited names and explanations otherwise remain retained verbatim; acceptance covers the three changes and examined contradictions, not a fresh audit of every retained row.
